d:
Dekha Teri Mast Nigahon Mein – Relive the magic of this evergreen Bollywood classic from Khiladi. Featuring the charismatic Akshay Kumar, this timeless melody continues to captivate music lovers with its unforgettable tune and romantic charm.
Enjoy this beautifully crafted and immerse yourself in the nostalgia of 90s Bollywood music.
Song: Dekha Teri Mast Nigahon Mein
Movie: Khiladi
Starring: Akshay Kumar, Ayesha Jhulka
Genre: Bollywood Romantic Song
Lyrics of Dekha Teri Mast Nigaho Me - dekha teri mast nigahon men
dekha teri mast nigaho me, nasha hai ada hai mohabbat hai
